ideas.name: Gold Delivery Month Return
ideas.claim: Gold futures showed a higher mean return during the final month before expiry, when trading overlaps with the delivery notice period.
ideas.quote: Whereas the term structure was almost flat for oil, gold clearly shows a higher mean return for the last month.
ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a mean monthly log return of 0.33% for the one-month gold contract, compared with -0.03% for the two-month contract.
